descriptions.d24f_release_entries_8029f48c: Releases every entry of the list at +336: for each non-null entry with an object, if slot 24 yields an owner it asks that owner (slot 96) to detach the object, releases the object (slot 16) and clears it; finishes and releases the entry's string at +8, releases any remaining object, deletes the entry through 0x801fe1f8, and finally resets the list end to its start.
